title: From Witness-Space Sharpness To Family-Pointwise Exactness For The Solvability Complexity Index
summary: We study how exact Solvability Complexity Index (SCI) statements should be formulated for families of computational problems rather than for single problems. While the equality \(\mathrm{SCI}_G (\mathcal P)=k\) is unambiguous for an individual computational problem \(\mathcal P\), the family setting requires one to distinguish family-pointwise exactness, witness-space sharpness, and worst-case exactness.
